intro: Share this Board as a live video. Anyone with the link can watch until you stop. Stopping ends the video and turns the link off; this panel tells you if that could not be confirmed. Each new broadcast gets a new link.
computer.hint: The video goes through this computer's Pipe program.
computer.none: Broadcasting needs a computer. Get one or move one here on the Computers page.
computer.partial: Couldn't read your whole computer list
warn.body: Everything on this Board is visible. Viewers see every tile as you see it, including terminals, files and anything you type: close what should stay private first. If this computer or its project only allows your own address, viewers will be refused, so check its access settings first.
warn.ok: I understand that viewers see the whole Board
start.needOk: Tick the box above to start.
start.needComputer: Choose a computer to send the video through.
stop: Stop and turn off the link
state.picking: Choose this tab in your browser's sharing window.
viewers.unknown: Number of watchers unavailable right now
confined.element: Only the tile area is shared.
confined.region: Only the tile area is shared. Menus opened over it are visible too.
confined.tab: This browser shares the whole tab, header included.
link.qrWarn: Anyone with this link can watch while you broadcast.
link.unknown: We could not confirm whether the viewer link was made. It may exist; if it does, it stops by itself within 15 minutes.
link.failed: The viewer link could not be made.
link.removalUnknown: We could not confirm that the link was turned off. It may still work.
link.removalFailed: The link could not be turned off. It still works.
link.removalFailedFix: To turn it off, go back to the Board and open Broadcast. It also turns off by itself when it expires.
link.removed: The link is off. It no longer opens.
link.expires: The link turns off by itself at {{time}}.
aliases.down: Viewer links are unavailable right now, so a broadcast can't start.
leftover.title: Earlier broadcast links on this computer
leftover.hint: Anyone who has one of these can still open it until it expires, and could send their own video to it while you're not broadcasting. Turn them off.
error.no-webm: This browser can't record the Board as video.
error.busy: Wait until the earlier viewer link is turned off.
error.not-this-tab: Share this tab only. The broadcast did not start: another tab or a window, or a tab that cannot be limited to the Board, could show other screens to viewers.
end.no-answer: The Pipe program did not answer, so the broadcast stopped.
end.refused: The Pipe program refused the broadcast.
end.taken: Someone else is using this broadcast name. Start a new broadcast.
end.busy: The Pipe program is too busy right now. Try again later.
end.server: The Pipe program ended the broadcast.
end.network: The connection to the Pipe program was lost.
end.slow: The connection was too slow, so the broadcast stopped.
end.recorder: Recording failed, so the broadcast stopped.
end.no-picture: No picture was captured, so the broadcast stopped. Try again.
unsupported.framed: Broadcasting needs the Hub in its own tab.
unsupported.no-capture: This browser can't share a tab.
unsupported.no-stream-upload: Broadcasting needs single-tab sharing and live uploads, and this browser can't send the Board live. Use an up-to-date Chrome or Edge.
unsupported.no-webm: This browser can't record the Board as video.
unsupported.no-crypto: This browser can't make a private link.
leave.title: Stop broadcasting?
leave.body: Leaving the Board ends the broadcast and turns off the viewer link.
link.notFound: No working viewer link was found. If one shows up under earlier links, turn it off there.
link.until: If this tab closes without stopping, the link turns off by itself by {{time}}.
link.renewFailed: The link could not be extended. It stops at {{time}} unless a later try works.
link.renewUnknown: We could not confirm that the link was extended. It may stop at {{time}}.
